steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Create project skeleton and add required files (index.html, style.css, script.js, app-meta.json, build-steps.json).

steps.title: Add Tailwind CSS via CDN
steps.description: Insert Tailwind CSS v4 browser CDN script into index.html and ensure it loads before custom CSS.

steps.title: Design Layout & UI
steps.description: Create a mobile‑first responsive layout with header, navigation, tool workspace, result area, and footer using Tailwind utility classes.

steps.title: Implement Dark Mode Support
steps.description: Add Tailwind dark mode configuration and CSS to toggle between light and dark themes based on user system preference.

steps.title: Build Text Input Component
steps.description: Add a textarea for user text input with proper ARIA labels, placeholder, and character counter.

steps.title: Create Action Buttons
steps.description: Add buttons for Analyze, Uppercase, Lowercase, Reverse, Copy, Download, Reset with loading states and disabled handling.

steps.title: Develop Result Display Area
steps.description: Add a section that shows word count, character count, reading time, and transformed text. Include empty‑state messaging.

steps.title: Write Core JavaScript Logic
steps.description: Implement input validation, text analysis functions, transformation functions, copy to clipboard, file download, and reset logic using async/await where appropriate.

steps.title: Add Accessibility Enhancements
steps.description: Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard‑focusable, have ARIA attributes, and provide meaningful focus styles.

steps.title: Responsive Testing & Bug Fixes
steps.description: Test layout on mobile, tablet, and desktop; fix any overflow, broken layout, or duplicate IDs.

steps.title: Error Handling & Edge Cases
steps.description: Add graceful handling for empty input, extremely long text, and clipboard permission errors. Show user‑friendly messages.

steps.title: Final Build – Building ProWebTool
steps.description: All files are ready for static hosting. Verify that the tool works end‑to‑end.
